title: Nourishing Earthy Ukrainian Graham Cracker Terrine
description: Rich, earthy, and delightfully fermented, this Ukrainian-inspired graham cracker terrine features a beurre-monte topping.

ingredients.name: Beurre-monte (coconut cream, lemon juice, and salt)

instructions: Combine graham cracker crumbs, almond milk, oat flour, and maple syrup in a bowl.
Mix until a dough forms and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Add yeast and mix until combined.
Transfer the dough to a terracotta dish and shape into a terrine form.
Cover the dish with a cloth and let it ferment at room temperature for 2 hours.
Place the terrine in the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Prepare the beurre-monte by whipping coconut cream, lemon juice, and salt in a separate bowl.
Top the terrine with the beurre-monte and garnish with chopped fresh dill.
Cover the terrine and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
